name: Hotosenaru Uta Chitosenaru Shirushi
original_name: ほとせなる呪ちとせなる詛
source:
Main character is visited by a girl who claims that his only distant relative taking care of her died in a fire. Mysterious death cases start to pursue protagonist. One of the latest victims blamed "email from a closed girl" curse as the cause of deaths.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名女孩前来拜访主人公，声称负责照顾她的唯一远亲已经死于火灾。此后，神秘死亡事件开始接连纠缠主人公。最近的一名死者把这些死亡归咎于"封闭少女寄来的电子邮件"所带来的诅咒。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
